[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Chak Fel]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]] owned a regal '''dress uniform''' that he wore for a [[First night's reception dinner (Chaf Envoy)|reception dinner]] aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss diplomatic vessel]] ''[[Chaf Envoy]]''. The dress uniform's upper left was covered with [[Ribbon/Legends|rows of colored bits of metal]] that denoted specific campaigns and victories.<ref name="SQ" />
